label: Utah FORGE Phase 3 MT resistivity volumes

scene.crs: local meters, X east, Y north, Z up

products.label: MT resistivity full-extent volume
products.description: Uncropped source-derived scalar volume resampled from every positive MT cell-center inversion row.
caveats: Source-derived visualization volume resampled from MT inversion cell centers.
Empty voxels are transparent through the occupancy mask.
Not an interpreted geological model, target, or resource estimate.

products.label: MT resistivity FORGE-focused volume
products.description: Meeting-focused scalar volume cropped around the MT station footprint and upper 30 km of the model.
caveats: Source-derived visualization volume resampled from MT inversion cell centers.
Empty voxels are transparent through the occupancy mask.
Not an interpreted geological model, target, or resource estimate.
